event: 2025 ILCA Senior Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b)
Race Committee represented by Robert Olsson.
NED 211160 represented by Stijn Van DER VALK.
Mattias Rahm attended the hearing as a witness.
Melker Ahlquist (RRS 42 Observer) attended the hearing as an observer.
The Race Committee presented video evidence.
facts: Within the last minute of the ILCA 7 Silver fleet starting signal for race number 9, CAN 211187 and NED 211160 were sailing within a distance of 60 meters from the pin end Race Committee vessel on the left extension of the starting line.
CAN 211187 and NED 211160 are in ILCA 7 Bronze fleet.
conclusions: By sailing less than 100m below the starting line or their extensions while their warning signal was not made but others were in a starting sequence, CAN 211187 and NED 211160 broke SI 12.6. APPLICABLE RULE: SI 12.6 and N1.4(b)
decision: Using the WS Discretionary Penalty Policy, a scoring penalty of 5% was decided to be applied to CAN 211187 and NED 211160 in race 9.
There were no circumstances to justify increasing or decreasing the penalty.
